Michael — thanks for the clear checklist. Sept 12 08:00–11:00 PT works from our side. Proposed mutual action plan below (high level):

1) Pre-delivery (today/EOD):
- We will upload signed_manifest_v2.json (SHA256 hashes + signer fingerprint) to the Drive link and send DocuSign for on-site acceptance.
- Vanessa will run the offline verification checklist against the signed bundle and provide the short operator procedure summary.

2) Courier & physical custody (Day-of):
- SecureCourier (logistics@secure-courier.com) will hand over sealed crate with magnetic seal IDs recorded in courier_label_SC-44123.pdf.
- Operator must verify physical seal ID against manifest before unboxing; photo of seal + operator badge required and appended to operator-acceptance-form.pdf.

3) Activation steps (on-site):
- Operator disables external management ports (no NAT, no external network) and mounts media to isolated loader.
- Loader verifies bundle signature against Redwood signer_cert_chain.pem and checks manifest hash.
- Operator signs acceptance form and sends the scanned copy to ops@acme-corp.com and to redwood-ops@redwoodinference.com.

4) Post-activation (same day):
- We will return a signed activation certificate and a short forensic snapshot (file sizes + checksums) to the Drive link.
- Any deviation triggers immediate hold and remote troubleshooting call.

Vanessa — can you attach the 3-bullet operator procedure and confirm our signer key id we plan to use (rwf-prod-2025-v2)? Marissa — ops escalation path if the signed verification fails?

Sean Gallagher
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

Michael / Sean — quick verification from the security side:

Operator procedure (3 bullets):
- Verify crate seal: visually inspect magnetic seal ID and photograph (front and close-up of ID) before any crate opening. Match ID to courier manifest.
- Verify image bundle: mount offline loader, run 'rw-verify --manifest signed_manifest_v2.json --key signer_cert_chain.pem'. Expect exit 0 and a checksum match printed to STDOUT.
- Activation: run isolated boot with the provided bundle; once boot completes, collect the /var/lib/rw_proof.txt (signed timestamp) and append to operator-acceptance-form.pdf along with operator badge scan.

Signer key: confirmed rwf-prod-2025-v2 (certificate chain attached). If verification fails at any step, stop and call the Redwood on-call line: +1 800 555 99.

I also noted we will use a 2-person witness for the handoff (courier + Acme field tech). Courier must photograph seal before handoff.

Vanessa Ortiz
